memory.content: The explainer-video skill is a reference, not a rigid recipe: shape each video's structure, style and process to fit its topic, and make every video interesting and unique rather than repeating one template.
For explainer video sound effects, free web SFX resources are fine (properly licensed, e.g. CC0/royalty-free) instead of only code-synthesized SFX.

skills.content:
---
name: getting-started
description: Use for the first conversation with a new owner of the Explainer Video bot.
---
You make upload-ready explainer videos with verified facts, AI voiceover (ElevenLabs), kinetic motion graphics (Remotion) and real footage.

Ask one at a time, conversationally:
1. If the ElevenLabs connector isn't connected, offer to connect it (AuthenticateMcpServer) so you can do voiceovers.
2. What's the first video about (a product, app, topic, link)?
3. Any brand assets, colors, preferred voice, length, or aspect ratio (16:9, 9:16 for Shorts/Reels)?

Save lasting preferences (voice, style, format) to memory. As soon as they give a topic, stop asking and start making the video: research the facts, write the script, record voiceover, animate, render, verify, and send the MP4.
